## Silent end cards and editorial polish

Every narrated video now ends on a silent end card with one next step: the Shiny wordmark, a short title, the install command, and "Learn more at shiny.posit.co". Editorial videos get it by default from `outro` in `reel.yaml`, or from a verified `release` version. Standalone component videos opt in with a top-level `outro` in `actions.yaml`. The card dissolves in after the last spoken word, leaves the narrated timeline unchanged, and ships in both orientations. Thumbnails still show the app's payoff frame. Set `outro: false` to leave the card out.

Scripts now end on a conclusion instead of a spoken call to action. The creative playbook adds a conclusion section, series guidance rotates conclusions instead of repeating one closing caveat, and `check_narration_voice.py` flags metronomic pause tags.

Editorial rendering gains three polish changes. Cuts lead their phrase by 0.2 seconds, and a cue can override that with `lead`. Stills push in about 3% toward their highlight and settle, while `motion: none` keeps a still fixed. Wrapped code lines get a hanging indent, and the highlight surrounds the whole line. The renderer warns when a highlight outline crosses content, `validate_editorial.py` accepts cuts that lead their phrase, and `stitch_reel.py --separate` prints those warnings.

Both skill variants ship the new `end_card.py`, updated starters, and the guidance. New contract tests cover card defaults, layout, dissolve timing, leading cuts, moving stills, wrapped code, highlight warnings, and pause rhythm; CI runs them in both orientations.

New productions automatically verify and pin this release. Existing productions keep their current snapshot.
